outcome.description: Evaluate the task deliverable, not overall release readiness. PASS when security-relevant claims and handling are adequate. FAIL when the deliverable itself has a security-quality defect. NOT_APPLICABLE when the task introduced no security-relevant implementation/change and an additional security gate adds no meaningful verification.

security_relevant.description: Whether this deliverable has an additional security-relevant aspect that this gate can meaningfully verify.

deliverable_security_defects.description: Concrete security-quality defects of the deliverable itself. Future product security work or vulnerabilities documented by a valid report are not deliverable security defects.
